item.name: Label Management
item.description: Admin label management: create via OR, usage count 0→1, invalid colour 4xx, admin-only listing/cascade endpoints, cascade delete sweeps task.labels. Requires the planninq app + register installed; admin auth. spec: openspec/changes/label-management-admin/specs/admin-user-settings/spec.md

request.description: Create a label directly on the OR label schema (ADR-022 create path).
Admin usage listing; the new label appears with usageCount 0.
Seed a task whose labels array contains the new label UUID.
After attaching to a task the usage count reflects 1.
A non-6-digit-hex colour must be rejected by OR schema validation (4xx).
Admin cascade delete: removes the UUID from referencing tasks then deletes the label; reports tasksUpdated.

item.name: Task labels no longer contain the UUID

request.description: The swept task must not retain a dangling label reference.

item.name: Task Collaboration
item.description: Comments (OR notes, ICommentsManager-backed) and audit trail on a task, via OpenRegister per-object APIs (ADR-022; no planninq pass-through). Covers notes CRUD on a seeded task (create -> list shows author+message -> edit own -> delete own), an RBAC-negative read for an inaccessible task, and the audit trail carrying the status-change entry after an update. spec: openspec/specs/task-collaboration.md
